title: session.ready — Session Ready
description: Server confirms session establishment. Client should use server_time_ms to compute clock offset for one-way delay calculations.

session_restored.description: True if a previous session was successfully restored (reconnection within 30s TTL).

server_time_ms.description: Server's current UTC wall-clock time in milliseconds. Client should compute: clock_offset = server_time_ms - local_time_at_receipt_ms.

keepalive_interval_s.description: Server-recommended heartbeat interval in seconds. Client should respect this value (default: 15).

server_version.description: Server package version (PEP 440, e.g. "0.1.0" or "0.1.0+20261017.ad2fa88"). Informational only; clients must not gate behavior on it.
